    let stack be an empty list of text
    if length of line is more than 0:
        let characters be line split by ""
        for each index from 1 to length of characters:
            let bracket be item index of characters
            if bracket is "(" or bracket is "[" or bracket is "{{":
                add bracket to stack
            otherwise:
                if length of stack is 0:
                    give back no
                let opening be item (length of stack) of stack
                if bracket is ")" and opening is not "(":
                    give back no
                if bracket is "]" and opening is not "[":
                    give back no
                if bracket is "}}" and opening is not "{{":
                    give back no
                remove item (length of stack) of stack
    give back length of stack is 0

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        repeat count times:
            let line be ask ""
            if (valid with line):
                say "valid"
            otherwise:
                say "invalid"

to valid with line as text giving yesno:
    let stack be an empty list of text
    let characters be line split by ""
    for each index from 1 to length of characters:
        let character be item index of characters
        if character is "(" or character is "[" or character is "{{":
            add character to stack
        otherwise:
            if length of stack is 0:
                give back no
            let opening be item (length of stack) of stack
            if character is ")" and opening is not "(":
                give back no
            if character is "]" and opening is not "[":
                give back no
            if character is "}}" and opening is not "{{":
                give back no
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
    give back length of stack is 0

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        give back
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        if (valid with line):
            say "valid"
        otherwise:
            say "invalid"

    let stack be an empty list of text

        let character be item index of characters

            add character to stack
        otherwise if character is "[":
            add character to stack
        otherwise if character is "{{":
            add character to stack
        otherwise:
            if length of stack is 0:
                give back no
            let top be item (length of stack) of stack
            if character is ")":
                if top is not "(":
                    give back no
            otherwise if character is "]":

                    give back no
            otherwise:

                    give back no
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
    give back length of stack is 0

        let count be value of count_input
        repeat count times:
            let line be ask ""
            if (valid with line):
                say "valid"
            otherwise:
                say "invalid"

            add end_value as text to pieces

        say ""

        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""

            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let run_start be value of first_input
            let previous be run_start
            let pieces be an empty list of text
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let current_input be ask for a number ""
                let current be value of current_input
                if current is previous + 1:
                    set previous to current
                otherwise:
                    append_run with run_start and previous and pieces
                    set run_start to current
                    set previous to current
            append_run with run_start and previous and pieces
            say pieces joined with ","

        add start_number as text to pieces
        if run_length is 2:
            add end_number as text to pieces

    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let pieces be an empty list of text
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let run_start be value of first_input
            let previous be run_start
            repeat count - 1 times:
                let current_input be ask for a number ""
                let current be value of current_input
                if current is previous + 1:
                    set previous to current
                otherwise:
                    append_range with run_start and previous and pieces
                    set run_start to current
                    set previous to current
            append_range with run_start and previous and pieces
            say pieces joined with ","

        say ""

            set last to next
        otherwise:
            add (compact_range with first and last) to pieces
            set first to next
            set last to next

    add (compact_range with first and last) to pieces
    say pieces joined with ","

        if count is more than 0:
            let run_start be item 1 of numbers

            if count is more than 1:

                    let current be item index of numbers
                    if current is run_end + 1:
                        set run_end to current
                    otherwise:
                        if run_end - run_start is at least 2:
                            add (run_start as text) + "-" + (run_end as text) to parts

                            add (run_start as text) to parts

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is not nothing:
        let count be value of count_input
        let totals be a map from text to number
        repeat count times:
            let line be ask ""
            let parts be line split by " "
            let name be item 1 of parts
            let change be (item 2 of parts) as number
            if totals contains name:
                set item name of totals to (item name of totals) + change
            otherwise:
                set item name of totals to change
        let names be keys of totals
        for each i from 1 to length of names:
            let name be item i of names
            let output_parts be an empty list of text
            add name to output_parts
            add (item name of totals) to output_parts
            say output_parts joined with " "

results.source_text:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        return
    let count be value of count_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let item_name be item 1 of parts
        let change be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if totals contains item_name:
            set item item_name of totals to (item item_name of totals) + change
        otherwise:
            set item item_name of totals to change
    let item_names be keys of totals
    for each i from 1 to length of item_names:
        let item_name be item i of item_names
        let output_parts be an empty list of text
        add item_name to output_parts
        add (item item_name of totals) to output_parts
        say output_parts joined with " "

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        return
    let count be value of count_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let change be item 2 of parts as number
        if totals contains name:
            set item name of totals to (item name of totals) + change
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to change
    let names be keys of totals
    for each i from 1 to length of names:
        let name be item i of names
        let output_parts be an empty list of text
        add name to output_parts
        add (item name of totals) as text to output_parts
        say output_parts joined with " "

results.source_text:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is not nothing:
        let count be value of count_input
        let totals be a map from text to number
        repeat count times:
            let line be ask ""
            let parts be line split by " "
            let name be item 1 of parts
            let change be (item 2 of parts) as number
            if totals contains name:
                set item name of totals to (item name of totals) + change
            otherwise:
                set item name of totals to change
        let names be keys of totals
        for each i from 1 to length of names:
            let name be item i of names
            let output_parts be an empty list of text
            add name to output_parts
            add (item name of totals) to output_parts
            say output_parts joined with " "
